learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected C is found in slot 3 and locked it in; alternatives included not there and finding B.
observations.exploration: Deleted B: slot 2 became empty while C remained slot 3. Search C reported stopped at slot 2, not found. Switched to gone marker: slot 2 became gone and search automatically reported passed slot 2, found in slot 3. Both outcome summaries retained.
observations.reveal: Explained empty slot as run ends here because insertion uses first free slot; gap breaks keys whose probe path crosses it; marker says keep looking. Mentioned marker accumulation slowing searches and occasional rebuild.
observations.visual: Actual 1257 × 936 dark screenshot inspected. Indexed eight-slot row, hatched gone cell, probe arcs and highlighted C visibly explain successful traversal. Full reveal fits tested viewport.

prediction.reason: Clear commitment tests distinction between physical presence and search reachability.

interaction.reason: Deletion-policy contrast changes visible search path and outcome.
interaction.evidence: Empty stops at 2; marker passes 2 to C at 3.

payoff.reason: Explains observed stop rule and consequence, with marker maintenance cost.

clarity.reason: Slot labels, probe path and retained outcomes make tested contrast easy to follow.

transfer.reason: General probe-path condition is explained, but no concrete new application tested or proposed.
transfer.evidence: Any key whose probe path crosses the gap.

accessibility.evidence: Keyboard, focus, contrast, phone, zoom and motion unknown.

surprise.reason: C remains stored but committed found prediction fails.
surprise.evidence: C at slot 3 with not-found result.

visualExplanation.reason: Slot state and probe arcs carry stop versus continue mechanism.
visualExplanation.evidence: Hatched gone cell and C highlight in screenshot.

playfulness.reason: Deletion policy toggle gives reversible experiment.

practicalValue.reason: Shows a concrete hash-table deletion implementation issue.

depth.reason: Search stopping invariant and marker accumulation cost add linked mechanisms.

complexity.reason: Connects collision placement, stop rule and deletion policy.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Tracks insertion invariant and how deletion invalidates it; all supported by eight slots.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Low; one delete, one search and one labeled toggle.
complexity.prerequisiteNovelty: moderate: hashing and linear probing introduced in prompt.
complexity.notationRepresentationBurden: low: letters and integer slot indices.

whyCool: Turning the empty gap into a gone marker makes the same search visibly pass slot two and find C.
caveat: One fixed three-key collision chain tested; no insertion or rebuild interaction.
missingEvidence: Alternate keys and larger collision chains not tested.
Keyboard, focus, contrast, phone, zoom/reflow and motion untested.
effort: Approximately 2 minutes of actual browser review.
